name: positioning
description: Dùng khi cần tra loi duoc tai sao khach chon MINH chu khong chon nguoi khac — positioning statement theo Promise + Proof + Path, ma tran khac biet so voi doi thu, category entry points, thap thong diep 3 tang va huong tagline. Kích hoạt khi người dùng nhắc 'dinh vi thuong hieu', 'positioning', 'USP', 'khac biet voi doi thu', 'tai sao khach chon minh', 'tai dinh vi', 'noi gi de khach nho', 'san pham giong het thi truong'. Không dùng cho — soi doi thu dang lam gi thi dung skill nghien-cuu-doi-thu; giong noi va tu vung khi viet thi dung skill brand-voice; viet cau slogan / headline poster hai lop thi dung skill copy-hai-lop; dong goi goi ban thi dung skill offer-design; ke hoach ra mat san pham thi dung skill go-to-market.
